description: A new VFX needs clients "mod": a block of the section (with the side "server" warning), a field naming one, one that is fine with "mod". Fields that name only the game's VFX need nothing of the kind.

diagnostics.message: no game-data catalog: 2 reference(s) to the game's items, templates, ... were not checked (make one with `kiln catalog`, or pass --catalog)

this mod has a field that names a new VFX but says "clients": "kiln": a client builds it at boot from the mod's own files, and the server never sends assets; declare "clients": "mod". A VFX of the game ("game:<name>") needs no such thing
a new VFX is drawn by clients, but side "server" mods do not load on a joined client (only when a player hosts); use side "both"
